<h2 id="(b)-DADA2-parity-%E2%80%94-error-rate-model">(b) DADA2 parity — error rate model<a class="anchor-link" href="#(b)-DADA2-parity-%E2%80%94-error-rate-model">¶</a></h2><p><strong>DADA2</strong> learns $Q$-indexed transition matrices; initialization follows <strong>Phred</strong> $P(\mathrm{error}) = 10^{-Q/10}$ with uniform substitutions $P(\mathrm{sub}) = P(\mathrm{error})/3$.
